title: Privacy Policy
meta_description: Template covering data controller identity, processing purposes, legal bases, retention, subject rights, international transfers and DPO contact. 【Legal.

blocks.x: How Achala IT Solutions Corporation collects, uses, shares and protects personal data across this website and our delivery operations, and the rights you can exercise over it.

Achala IT Solutions Corporation (“Achala IT Solutions”, “we”) is the controller for personal data processed through achalasolutions.com and the contact routes it publishes. Delivery entities in the United States, United Kingdom, India and Bulgaria act as processors for client engagements under the terms of each contract.

We process identification and contact data you provide (name, work email, phone, role), correspondence content, engagement and billing records where contractually required, recruitment application data, and technical data collected when you browse this site (IP address, device and browser characteristics, pages visited, referring URL).

Contact and briefing requests are processed on the basis of performing pre-contractual steps at your request (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)); site analytics on the basis of legitimate interests in operating and improving the site (Art. 6(1)(f)); optional marketing communications only with your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)); and legal or tax obligations where applicable (Art. 6(1)(c)). You can withdraw consent at any time without affecting prior processing.

We share personal data only with service providers bound by data-processing agreements (site hosting, CRM, email delivery), with professional advisers under confidentiality, and with authorities where the law requires it. Transfers outside the EEA or UK rely on adequacy decisions or the UK/EU Standard Contractual Clauses, supplemented by transfer risk assessments.

Enquiry records are kept up to 24 months from last contact; recruitment records for the duration of the hiring round plus 12 months unless you ask us to keep them for future roles; contractual records per statutory limitation periods; analytics data in aggregated or pseudonymous form for up to 26 months.

Subject to local law you can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and object to processing based on legitimate interests or to direct marketing. Submit requests through the contact routes on our Contact page; we respond within one month of identity verification and explain any extension.

Questions or complaints about privacy can be sent to info@achalasolutions.com, marked for the attention of the privacy function. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
